description: This file defines the Error package for exception handling in Perl, including classes Error and Error::Simple, as well as error handling functions and overloads. It provides an OO interface for errors, with methods for creating, throwing, catching, and managing error objects, along with stack trace and error propagation features.

classes.name: Error
classes.description: Base class for error objects, providing methods for error information, stack trace, association with objects, and error throwing.

classes.name: Error::Simple
classes.description: A subclass of Error for simple string-based errors, with constructors and stringification overload.

methods.name: import
methods.description: Imports exception handling clauses and error handling features based on tags.

methods.name: prior
methods.description: Returns the last error created or associated with a package.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Clears the last error stored, either globally or for a specific package.

methods.name: stacktrace
methods.description: Returns the stack trace if debugging is enabled, or a summary of where the error occurred.

methods.name: associate
methods.description: Associates an error object with another object for error propagation.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructs a new Error object, capturing caller info and optional stack trace.

methods.name: throw
methods.description: Throws the error object, either creating a new one or rethrowing an existing one.

methods.name: with
methods.description: Creates a new Error object for syntactic sugar with 'die with'.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Creates and returns a new Error object for recording errors.

methods.name: catch
methods.description: Defines a catch clause for handling specific error classes.

methods.name: object
methods.description: Returns the object associated with the error.

methods.name: file
methods.description: Returns the filename where the error was created.

methods.name: line
methods.description: Returns the line number where the error was created.

methods.name: stringify
methods.description: String overload method returning the error message.

methods.name: value
methods.description: Returns an associated value with the error.
